verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM deals and engagements, so an agent can read email and meeting activity and write back deal updates. This is reinforced by the webhooks journal API for real-time CRM events and inbox connection that logs email replies to the CRM. HubSpot's native 'smart deal progression' and post-meeting automatic CRM updates show the signal-to-deal-update pattern is a supported first-party workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs of deal-stage/pipeline property updates via the deals API or MCP tools, a documented next-step field write path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven deal updates.
